summary: Official certificate determining minimum government circle rate valuation of real estate for visa, probate, or bank mortgage.

steps.title: Identify sector, floor, and road width
steps.description: Circle rate valuations vary based on whether property abuts main sector avenue or internal road.

steps.title: Apply online on Revenue Portal
steps.description: Input plot size, constructed area by floor, and year of construction.

steps.title: Algorithmic circle rate assessment
steps.description: System multiplies carpet area by notification circle rates and applies age depreciation.

steps.title: Issuance of certified valuation
steps.description: Sub-Registrar issues digitally signed Valuation Certificate with QR code verification.
